speaker: Adventurer
original_en:
Hello there, fellow adventurers! Listen up!
I encountered these monsters the other day <PART> ---- <PART> ---
lizardmen. Ever heard of 'em? Anyway,
they're constantly on the defensive! <PART> ---
Each time I'd strike them up front,
they'd parry my blow! <PART> ---
If it weren't for their blocking,
they wouldn't be such a pain.
original_jp: あら 貴方も同業者？聞いてよ！ この間嫌な魔物に会っちゃってさ <PART> リザードマンって知ってる？アイツら 守りには異常に長けててさ <PART> こっちが繰り出す正面からの剣をことごとく防いじゃうのよ まいったわ <PART> それさえなければ アイツら自身は大した相手じゃないんだけどね

speaker: Adventurer
original_en:
The lizardmen appear to be using
weapons left inside the ruins. <PART> ---
You never know <PART> ---- <PART> they could be holding
some precious artifact!
original_jp: リザードマンの武〓ってさ 〓〓の中に残されてた物を使用してるっぱいのよね <PART> …もしかして 意外に貴重な〓〓品なんか持ってたりするのかしら？

speaker: Lady
original_en:
I fled Solde to come here, but
Villnore has problems of its own!
original_jp: ソルデから〓って来たんだけど…ヴィルノアも大変な事になってるみたい

speaker: Adventurer
original_en:
You know how Dipan was flattened? Well,
Solde was in the wake of the aftershocks.
original_jp: ディパンが滅んだって聞いた？ソルデなんかその余波を〓っちゃって大変よ

speaker: Adventurer
original_en:
All the people capable of leaving Solde
are pouring out of the town. <PART> ---
The only ones left are children, the elderly,
and those with nowhere else to go.
original_jp: 〓住する力がある人は ソルデからどんどん出てってるらしいわね <PART> 残るのは 行き先の無い老人と子どもぐらいじゃないかな…

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Will you be staying?
We have a room with a view available.
original_jp: 〓まりかしら？〓めのいい部屋が空いてますよ

speaker: Owner
original_en: Welcome. Would you like a room?
original_jp: いらっしゃいませ お〓りですか？

speaker: Owner
original_en: Oh my, guests looking for a room?
original_jp: おっと 〓まりのお〓かな？

speaker: Owner
original_en: Yer travelers, right? Ya gonna stay?
original_jp: 旅人さんだね 〓まっていくかい？

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Greetings and Salutations. You look like
you're looking for a room. Am I right?
original_jp: いらっしゃーいええと 〓まり…よね？

speaker: Owner
original_en:
It is an honor to receive your visit.
Shall I book your room?
original_jp: ようこそお出で下さいましたお〓りでしょうか？

speaker: Owner
original_en:
That's a shame.
Come back if you change your mind.
original_jp: そうですか…またの機会をお待ちしてますね

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Please visit us again,
when you have the chance.
original_jp: 機会がありましたら〓非当〓をご利用下さい

speaker: Owner
original_en: It figures. And I got all worked up.
original_jp: なんじゃ 久しぶりの〓かと思ったのにのう…

speaker: Owner
original_en: Be on yer way then, no loiterin'.
original_jp: おや 〓やかしは御免だよ

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Well, it's your loss.
You're missing out on great service.
original_jp: 何だ 残念～ウチはサービスいいのに

speaker: Owner
original_en:
If ever the opportunity should arise,
please pay us your custom again.
original_jp: ご縁がありましたらまたいらして下さいね

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Let the lullaby of the waves
be your invitation to slumber.
original_jp: 波の〓は〓りを誘う子守〓ごゆっくりお〓み下さい

speaker: Owner
original_en: Please enjoy your stay.
original_jp: それでは どうぞごゆっくりとお〓み下さい

speaker: Owner
original_en:
So you're really staying?
Take a load off!
original_jp: おお そうか〓まるかゆっくり〓んどくれよ

speaker: Owner
original_en:
I just cleaned the sheets.
Yer gonna sleep like a baby!
original_jp: シーツは洗い立てだからね気持ちよく〓れるよ！

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Balanced breakfast on the house!
Sleep tight.
original_jp: ご〓大〓りサービスするわねごゆっくり～

speaker: Owner
original_en:
You must be exhausted.
Please make yourself comfortable.
original_jp: お疲れでしょう？ゆっくりしていって下さいね

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Visit again soon!
May the blessings of the sea be with you.
original_jp: いってらっしゃいませ海の女神の加護があらんことを

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Thank you for your patronage.
Please take care.
original_jp: ご利用ありがとうございましたお気をつけて

speaker: Owner
original_en: Come by any time you're in the area.
original_jp: 近くに来たら また〓っておくれよ

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Ya got a good night's rest, didn't ya?
Watch yer back out there!
original_jp: ぐっすり〓れたろ？気をつけていっておいで！

speaker: Owner
original_en: Hehe, did you sleep okay? Come again soon!
original_jp: ふふ ゆっくり出来た？ また来てね～

speaker: Owner
original_en:
I trust you rested well.
We look forward to serving you again soon.
original_jp: 疲れは取れましたか？お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ

speaker: Owner
original_en: Uh-oh, you don't have enough money.
original_jp: あら 宿〓〓がちょっと足りないみたい…

speaker: Owner
original_en:
I'm afraid it would be impossible to allow
you to stay without paying the proper fee.
original_jp: 宿〓〓をお支払いになれませんとお〓めする事が難しいのですが…

speaker: Owner
original_en: Oh, this won't do. You can't afford it.
original_jp: なんじゃ 金が無きゃ〓められんぞ

speaker: Owner
original_en:
This ain't enough! Whaddaya tryna pull?
This is a business, ya know!
original_jp: お金貫わなきゃ〓められないよウチも〓売だからね

speaker: Owner
original_en:
Hmm... Looks like you're a little short.
Come back when you have the money!
original_jp: う～ん…ちょっとお金足りないわね…〓いだらまた来てね～

speaker: Owner
original_en:
I'm afraid we require full payment
in advance in order to allocate rooms.
original_jp: お〓様 代金が若干足りないようですので今回はちょっと…
